summary: Aethlon Medical filed an 8-K on June 4, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering. The company, through an ATM agreement with H.C. Wainwright, can now sell up to $542,716 in common stock, in addition to $1,849,457 previously sold. As of June 1, 2026, outstanding shares were 2,344,886, with a public float of 2,337,629. The placement is registered under an existing Form S-3. This is a routine capital-raising update, not a special situation event.
